evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?" — asked after item/oversized/packing probing was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer flagged a real concern about a religious friend possibly being suspicious of the crew, plus a dog that needs containing; rep answered with one acknowledgment ("Of course... we don't want to stress them up as well and for the safety of the guys") without asking what else might come up
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we only charge in fifteen minute intervals" (beats-it-pay-less) + extensive moving-vs-packing window framing + explicit trade-off on doing his own packing to cut cost (self-prep tip) — three of five lines present

top_strength: Handled a genuinely tense, budget-anxious customer (tight timeline, a skeptical third-party friend, hard dollar ceiling) with real patience, walking through moving-only versus moving-plus-packing math multiple times without getting impatient.
coaching_note: Call ended without any explicit ask or rate-lock line — customer said he'd "review with my friend," which is exactly the moment a light close ("want me to go ahead and hold that morning/afternoon slot for you?") could have converted uncertainty into a tentative booking.
